name: Steak with Balsamic Reduction & Garlic Zucchini Sauté

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Wash and dry zucchini and parsley. Trim zucchini ends; halve lengthwise and slice into half rounds. Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 cloves garlic
6 zucchini
1 ½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add garlic and crushed red pepper and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp virgin coconut oil
⅜ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add zucchini, salt, and pepper. Stirring frequently, cook until tender and lightly browned, 5-6 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and stir in parsley.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅜ tsp salt
3 pinches black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet to stove and add more oil. Season steak with salt and pepper and place in skillet. Cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp virgin coconut oil
1.02 kg ribeye steak

instructions.primary_message: Discard any fat from skillet, return to stove, and reduce heat to medium-low. Add vinegar, salt, and pepper. Cook until reduced by about ½, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cup balsamic vinegar
⅜ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice steak against the grain. Add any accumulated juices to skillet and stir to combine.
To serve, place steak and zucchini on a plate and drizzle with balsamic reduction. Enjoy!
